name: Steffen Kux
description: Steffen is Co-Founder and Co-CEO of corpus.core, focusing on trustless blockchain infrastructure, stateless verification, and privacy-preserving client architectures. With more than 25 years of experience in software architecture and distributed systems, he has been building blockchain infrastructure since the early Ethereum ecosystem. He coordinates the development & application of colibri, an open-source stateless client for trustless blockchain verification.
